description: Metadata for confirmed public World Economic Forum research and news HTML about artificial intelligence on www.weforum.org and weforum.org. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded HTML GET that robots.txt allowed. A Cloudflare challenge, a captcha, an authentication wall, an HTML document in place of robots.txt, a host that does not resolve, an HTTP error, a non-HTML body, a robots disallow, or a redirect off these hosts is not stored. An empty entries list is valid. Person profiles, login walls, PDFs, and unrelated topics are omitted. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, publication date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, quotes, transcripts, chart data, and PDFs are not stored. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A sole restricted deed keeps its own token. A missing publication date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. This catalog is not a belief collector and runner_wired is false.
